reviews.evidence: Ships a bounded Markdown-memory protocol with curation, continuity sync, validation, host adapters, read-only readers, and careful uninstall behavior; the README gives several concrete memory and handoff scenarios plus unusually broad limits, security, compatibility, and failure evidence.
reviews.concern: Most commands are installation or host wiring, and the README shows no representative memory artifact or concrete before/after output.

reviews.evidence: Covers database connection, schema exploration, natural-language SQL analysis, follow-up investigation, governance, charts, dashboards, and offline reports, with Web/TUI workflows, five concrete business prompts, and screenshots of distinct product states.
reviews.concern: Reliability evidence is mainly compatibility and read-only/privacy behavior; the README provides no test results, troubleshooting workflow, or demonstrated failure recovery.

reviews.evidence: A comprehensive coding-agent harness spanning TUI and headless runs, sessions, tools, skills, permissions, hooks, lazy MCP, subagents, and multiple model APIs; it supplies an extensive command reference, measured footprint/cache results, screenshots, exit behavior, limits, and safety modes.
reviews.concern: Despite the broad operational reference, explicit task scenarios are relatively sparse and mostly short examples or role-table entries rather than worked cases.

reviews.evidence: The catalog’s own workflow is concrete and end-to-end: query the GitHub topic, shortlist matches, inspect packaging, explain differences, audit security-sensitive behavior, request consent, then install and verify; two discovery scenarios are explicitly named.
reviews.concern: There is no sample result, comparison output, screenshot, test evidence, troubleshooting guidance, or recovery path for failed discovery or installation.

reviews.evidence: Combines novel and short-drama production workflows with delivered skills, roles, staged Markdown artifacts, navigation, previews, safe editing, and native DSH review surfaces; slash-command entry points and two workflow GIFs make the core paths actionable and visible.
reviews.concern: The README names many creative stages but provides few worked prompts or concrete final story artifacts, so explicit use-case and output evidence remains limited.

reviews.evidence: An unusually complete compatibility system with package lifecycle operations, ABI translation, UI and runtime mappings, OAuth, subagents, inspection tools, a detailed MCP walkthrough, many runnable examples, per-plugin outcomes, capability matrices, contract tests, limitations, and recovery guidance.
reviews.concern: Some catalog-wide evidence is explicitly only mount/probe coverage rather than proof of each plugin’s real user workflow, a distinction the README itself carefully warns about.

reviews.evidence: Ships aggregate anime search, conversational pagination, result cards, resource details, magnet/torrent actions, Bangumi enrichment, configurable streaming rules and playback, settings, and updates; usage, advanced rule configuration, migration, acceptance, security limits, fallback behavior, and troubleshooting are all documented.
reviews.concern: Only a few explicit user scenarios and two main result screenshots are shown, so the extensive capability and reliability evidence is not matched by equally broad case-study demonstrations.

reviews.evidence: A broad ready-to-run DSH distribution with GUI/TUI session continuity, editable agent presets, workspace files/Git/terminal/browser/diffs, model choices, plugin and Host management, source builds, diagnostics, stale-cache recovery, platform constraints, and credential/privacy boundaries.
reviews.concern: The README shows the two interfaces but no detailed coding task from input through reviewed changes and outcome; project status is also explicitly developer preview with changing upstream compatibility.

reviews.evidence: An exceptional end-to-end office system spanning Sheets, Docs, Slides, Bases, Boards, Office import/export, isolated drafts, live review, verification and linting, with multiple worked prompts, request/live/review screenshots, a video, detailed tools, limits, timeouts, tests, and explicit unsupported areas.
reviews.concern: Some advanced Office features and Board export remain unsupported, and parts of Slide verification require a separately available local Chrome/Chromium executable.

reviews.evidence: Provides a multi-note Web app plus DSH and other-agent workflows, themed image/Markdown/HTML exports, images, publishing, AI polishing, persistence, multi-user isolation, and private Docker deployment; concrete prompts and many screenshots/GIFs demonstrate several distinct outputs.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance beyond the DSH/skill prompts and Docker path is thin, while reliability evidence lacks tests, compatibility results, failure behavior, and a troubleshooting section.
